TwoLevelMediationData Class

Source: R/classes-twolevel.R
TwoLevelMediationData.Rd

Experimental. This class, twolevel_statistic() and the level argument of the effect generics may change without the usual deprecation period (a native two-level fitter, a later milestone, could change the object).

Usage

TwoLevelMediationData(
  a_within, b_within, c_prime_within, a_between, b_between, c_prime_between,
  estimates, vcov, parameter_table, treatment, mediator, outcome, cluster, n_obs,
  n_clusters, cluster_sizes, icc, between_identified, admissible, converged,
  cross_level_equal, fixed_paths, source, fixed_x, information, h1_information,
  se_type, estimator, missing, lavaan_version, call, between_parameterization,
  data, source_package
)

Arguments

a_within, b_within, c_prime_within

Numeric scalars: within-level paths (always finite).

a_between, b_between, c_prime_between

Numeric scalars: between-level paths; NA_real_ when between_identified is FALSE.

estimates

Named numeric vector of the identified path rows, in the order above.

vcov

Covariance matrix of estimates: the sub-block of the fit's joint covariance, so the cross-level covariances are carried.

parameter_table

Data frame, one row per path row (path, level, lhs, op, rhs, label, free, est, se), kept for audit.

treatment, mediator, outcome, cluster

Character scalars: variable names.

n_obs, n_clusters

Integer scalars: rows used and number of clusters.

cluster_sizes

Integer vector of cluster sizes (length n_clusters).

icc

Named numeric vector: intraclass correlation of treatment, mediator and outcome.

between_identified

Logical scalar: whether the between level is identified.

admissible

Logical scalar: lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "post.check").

converged

Logical scalar: whether the fit converged.

cross_level_equal

Character vector: paths ("a", "b", "c_prime") equated across levels.

fixed_paths

Character vector: path rows with free == 0 (variance 0 in vcov).

source

Character scalar: "lavaan" or "native".

fixed_x, information, h1_information, se_type, estimator, missing

How the fit was made, read from it.

lavaan_version, call

Character scalars: provenance of the fit.

between_parameterization

Character scalar: "latent" (cluster means are latent).

data

Data frame or NULL: always NULL for the lavaan adapter (the fit is never refit and the data are not copied); kept for the contract shared with the other mediation classes, which read @data.

source_package

Character scalar: "lavaan"; kept for the dependents contract shared with the other mediation classes (tests/testthat/test-dependents-contract.R pins it across classes).

Value

A TwoLevelMediationData S7 object.

Details

S7 class for two-level mediation in which treatment, mediator and outcome are all measured on level-1 units nested in clusters (1-1-1), with the paths estimated separately at the within and the between level (latent cluster means, fixed slopes). Built by extract_mediation() from a lavaan two-level fit; the same class is the target of a native fitter later (source says which).

Per level the indirect effect is \(NIE_l = a_l b_l\), the direct effect is \(c'_l\), and the contrast \(NIE_w - NIE_b\) is descriptive, not a test. When the between level cannot be identified (for example a treatment with no between-cluster variance) the object is within-only: the between properties are NA_real_ and the between rows are absent from estimates and vcov.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("lavaan", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  id <- rep(1:60, each = 5)
  xb <- stats::rnorm(60)[id]
  x <- xb + stats::rnorm(300)
  m <- 0.5 * x + stats::rnorm(60)[id] + stats::rnorm(300)
  y <- 0.4 * m + 0.2 * x + stats::rnorm(60)[id] + stats::rnorm(300)
  d <- data.frame(id = id, X = x, M = m, Y = y)
  model <- "
    level: 1
      M ~ X
      Y ~ M + X
    level: 2
      M ~ X
      Y ~ M + X
  "
  fit <- lavaan::sem(model, data = d, cluster = "id")
  td <- extract_mediation(fit, treatment = "X", mediator = "M", outcome = "Y")
  td@a_within * td@b_within
}
#> [1] 0.2498413
# }
